decision: Portfolio priority briefs (#3198/#3201) remain propose-not-apply; operator dispose of shortlist/park MUST land in a structured decision record via task decision:write (or interim issue comment until this surface existed), not chat alone or the brief file as SoT.

governingRule.description: Propose-not-apply: brief proposes; operator disposes. Brief is not the decision record.

alternativesConsidered.option: Treat the priority brief markdown as the durable dispose record
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Briefs re-open debate; no required revisit trigger or alternatives

alternativesConsidered.option: Auto-promote shortlist into plan-sequence without human dispose

whyWinner: A thin decision log event preserves park/promote rationale and revisit triggers across multi-agent handoff without merging #1513 lessons or boiling #2741 memory.
revisitTrigger: After two portfolio passes where agents still re-litigate park/promote despite decision records, revisit UX of decision:list / skill dispose checklist. If plan-sequence absorbs dispose fully for ordered work, keep decision log for process/architecture only.
